description: This source file provides utility functions for handling HTTP responses and requests within a Node.js/Express.js application. It includes functions for parsing pagination parameters, sending success and failure responses, and wrapping asynchronous route handlers to handle errors.

methods.name: parsePagination
methods.description: Parses pagination parameters ('page' and 'limit') from the query object, applying default values and constraints, and calculates the 'skip' value for database queries.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Sends a successful HTTP response with a JSON payload indicating success, including data and optional metadata.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Sends an error HTTP response with a JSON payload indicating failure, including an error message and optional details.

methods.name: asyncHandler
methods.description: Wraps an asynchronous route handler function to catch and forward errors to Express' error handling mechanism.
